title: Merge Bookings
statement: A meeting room's bookings are given as [start, end] in any order. Bookings that overlap or touch (one ends exactly when the next starts) form one busy block. Return the busy blocks sorted by start.

answerKey.pattern: Sort by start, then merge into the last block
keyPoints: If a booking starts at or before the last block's end, extend that end with max
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Mark every time unit on a timeline: O(range)

hints: After sorting by start, which block can a booking join?
Only the last block: earlier blocks end before the last one starts.
If start <= last end, set last end = max(last end, end); else push a new block.
